status: formal cold-start release; G3 PASS under revision R1; T_diag uncalibrated (pending ruling); §2.5 locked benchmark run 2026-10-18, not significant vs. the v1 frozen CAPE-V severity head

contract.input: segment A: 16 kHz mono waveform, or a raw recording (stage 0 is bundled)
contract.output: abi_prime [0,10], y_hat_mm = 10 * abi_prime (PVQD CAPE-V overall severity, mm), s [0,100]
contract.validated_input: PVQD protocol compound recordings (sustained /a/, /i/ + six CAPE-V sentences), whole file through stage 0
contract.out_of_scope: any-recording vowel cutting; the front end that locates and cuts a sustained vowel does not exist yet
contract.health_to_severity_mapping: none; abi_prime is CAPE-V severity / 10 directly

pipeline.chain: stage 0 segment A -> native 9 features -> L3 linear head -> clip [0,10] (G6 identity) -> g table -> S
pipeline.head: single affine linear regression (refit L3, lambda = 100)

package_layout.weights/model.json: L3 coefficients, clip, g version, cold-start thresholds, dev metrics, package identity
package_layout.weights/g_table.json: dimension chain g constant table (knots / p / sigma) with its acceptance record
package_layout.inference/stage0/: stage 0, seg_ver stage0-v0.2.1.2 (13 modules, byte-identical to the frozen prediction run)
package_layout.inference/native_features/: native nine-feature engine (5 modules, byte-identical to the frozen prediction run)
package_layout.history/v0.1-pre/: archived v0.1-pre package (card, weights, entry point)

training_data.label: PVQD CAPE-V overall severity average / 10
training_data.caliber: relaxed / training (R1 and W_窗数 not excluded)

locked_benchmark.comparator: v1 frozen CAPE-V severity head (native mm, not recomputed)
locked_benchmark.verdict: not significant; do not claim v0.2.3.3 beats the v1 severity head on the locked set
locked_benchmark.strata_descriptive: Normal/Mild comparable; Moderate/Severe descriptively weaker for v0.2.3.3

disclosures.product_caliber: 22 scored / 36 rejected:R1, descriptive only, not part of any endpoint

release_selfcheck.what: re-ran the 58 locked recordings through this package's own entry point and compared against the frozen prediction file

cold_start_thresholds.status: UNCALIBRATED placeholder (T_diag from the L0 spec does not carry over to the severity label); the package therefore emits measurements only, no product band decision
